extraction: Raw VizieR asu-tsv response saved verbatim. Rows counted after skipping '#' comment lines, the header line, the units line and the '---' separator line; blank trailing lines excluded.
note: Sohn et al. 2017 ApJS 229, 20, Table 2: 982 SPECTROSCOPIC MEMBERS of ABELL 2029 (MMT/Hectospec plus SDSS). MEMBERSHIP: inclusion in this table IS the membership determination (caustic technique). MEASURED: RAJ2000/DEJ2000; cz and its error in km/s -- note the redshift is given as cz, so z = cz/299792.458; sigma = central stellar VELOCITY DISPERSION within a rest-frame 3 kpc aperture, with error (f_sigma flags rows where the uncertainty is unavailable) -- a genuine kinematic observable; Dn4000 = 4000 Angstrom break index; r_cz = redshift provenance; T13 = cross-match flag to Tyler+2013 within 2 arcsec. NOT PRESENT: stellar mass, magnitudes/colours, effective radius Re, Sersic index n, axis ratio q, position angle theta.
